commander_identity.mechanical_plan: Inalla, Archmage Ritualist ({2}{U}{B}{R} 4/5 legendary Human Wizard; Commander 2017, released 2017-08-25; commander-legal, not a Game Changer, no project exception). Eminence: whenever another nontoken Wizard you control enters, if Inalla is in the command zone or on the battlefield, you may pay {1} to create a hasty token copy that is exiled at the next end step. Tap five untapped Wizards: target player loses 7 life. Plan (owner blueprint 2026-10-14): run Eminence from the command zone as the combo engine. Spellseeker + Eminence finds the Scholar of the Ages / sacrifice / Finale of Promise lines; Bloodline Necromancer + Ruthless Technomancer + Inalla loops; Apprentice Necromancer's hasty copy reanimates at once; Thundertrap Trainer doubles selection. Backups: Thassa's Oracle + Demonic Consultation / Tainted Pact and Underworld Breach + Lion's Eye Diamond + Brain Freeze.
commander_identity.natural_ceiling: Power Bracket 5 (cEDH), unchanged. Game Changers: 18 in both baseline and candidate (Ad Nauseam, Ancient Tomb, Chrome Mox, Demonic Tutor, Force of Will, Gamble, Grim Monolith, Imperial Seal, Intuition, Lion's Eye Diamond, Mana Vault, Mox Diamond, Mystical Tutor, Necropotence, Rhystic Study, Thassa's Oracle, Underworld Breach, Vampiric Tutor). The owner's decisions file records 2026 Inalla tournament top cuts.
commander_identity.anti_homogenization: Commander-first to Inalla's Oracle: no generic Grixis staple is added. Distinctness (nonbasic names shared with the most similar approved Grixis decks, baseline = candidate, canonical Archidekt exports): Kefka, Court Mage 72; Kess, Dissident Mage 71; Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge 68; Evelyn, the Covetous 68; Fire Lord Azula 67. The overlap is the cEDH staple core (fast mana, tutors, free counters, Oracle/Breach). Inalla stays commander-first through the Wizard ETB package doubled by Eminence (Spellseeker/Scholar of the Ages, Bloodline Necromancer + Ruthless Technomancer, Apprentice Necromancer, Thundertrap Trainer, Vedalken Aethermage) and the tap-five finisher. Owner-removed or rejected cards and classes (Dualcaster Mage, Snapcaster Mage, Archaeomancer, Brainstorm, Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Force of Negation, Naban, Kess, Patron Wizard, Panharmonicon/Molten Echoes Wizard-value, Micromancer, Samut, Spectral Arcanist, Orcish Bowmasters, Pyroblast, Daze, Starting Town) are not re-added.

whole_deck_audit.roles_and_overlaps: All 99 library cards (99 rows; 1x Island, 1x Swamp; 100 distinct names for Tainted Pact) were reviewed. Roles: 27 lands; 14 creatures (Wizards: Spellseeker, Scholar of the Ages, Bloodline Necromancer, Ruthless Technomancer, Apprentice Necromancer, Thundertrap Trainer, Vedalken Aethermage, Kefka, Thassa's Oracle; non-Wizards: Hexing Squelcher, Blood Pet, Hoarding Broodlord, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, Simian Spirit Guide); fast mana (Sol Ring, Mana Vault, Grim Monolith, Chrome Mox, Mox Diamond, Mox Opal, Lotus Petal, Lion's Eye Diamond, Talismans, Arcane Signet, Fellwar Stone, rituals); tutors (Demonic, Vampiric, Imperial Seal, Mystical, Gamble, Intuition, Lim-Dûl's Vault, Beseech the Mirror, Wishclaw Talisman, Entomb); reanimation (Reanimate, Animate Dead, Shallow Grave, Persist, Unearth, Lively Dirge, Unmarked Grave); sacrifice (Culling the Weak, Burnt Offering, Sacrifice, Saw in Half); stack interaction (Force of Will, Pact of Negation, Flusterstorm, Swan Song, Mental Misstep, Red Elemental Blast, An Offer You Can't Refuse, Chain of Vapor); engines (Necropotence, Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Ad Nauseam, Wheel of Fortune, Final Fortune, Underworld Breach, Brain Freeze, Borne Upon a Wind, Essence Flux, Step Through, Finale of Promise, Demonic Consultation, Tainted Pact). Overlaps: Intuition/Gifts, Entomb/Buried Alive, Saw in Half/Twinflame judged in the candidate list.
whole_deck_audit.mana_base_and_curve: Unchanged (zero swaps). 27 lands, U/B/R sources 20/19/17 (fetches and rainbow lands counted per colour). 72 nonland cards; curve MV0 6, MV1 25, MV2 25, MV3 7, MV4 2, MV5 5, MV7+ 2 (Scholar of the Ages 7, Hoarding Broodlord 8); average nonland MV 2.0; 14 creatures; 13 artifacts. Lands-only exact castability at 10 cards seen: {1}{U} Wizards 0.8045, {1}{R}{R} 0.4605, 4 lands with U 0.2717, 5 lands 0.0958 (bounded T1).
whole_deck_audit.interaction_resilience: Free and cheap stack protection (Force of Will, Pact of Negation, Flusterstorm, Swan Song, Mental Misstep, Red Elemental Blast, An Offer You Can't Refuse) plus Hexing Squelcher (our spells can't be countered; ward for our other creatures; no commander dependence) and Chain of Vapor / Otawara bounce. The deck is weak to graveyard hate and to Rest in Peace-style effects; Breach, Oracle and Bloodline loops give non-graveyard routes. Unchanged by this pass.

material_candidates.commander_synergy: The strongest commander-native evidence in the pool. It is a Wizard, so the Eminence copy gives two spell copies for {1}. With Saw in Half (already in the 99) it makes unbounded hasty tokens that Inalla's tap-five ability turns into a win (Spellbook 147-500). With Essence Flux (already in the 99) it loops nontoken entries that each trigger Eminence (147-4598). Spellbook: 16 -> 18 included combos. Lands-only RR castability at 10 cards seen is 0.4605, against Kefka's 5-land 0.0958.
material_candidates.adversarial_downside: Dualcaster Mage was REMOVED by the owner in the 2026-10-14 rebuild (canonical decisions file, 'Cut 49 baseline cards'); the brief forbids re-adding removed cards. It dies to every edict and needs a live spell on the stack. Cutting Kefka cuts an owner addition. cEDH adoption is low (0.29).
material_candidates.reason: Evidence is real but it re-adds an owner-removed card over an owner addition. Staged as an OWNER DECISION (complete 100 in the research pool); NOT counted as a genuine swap.
